units.source_text: 你是所谓‘众手都来拉’的纸币吧！

en.t: So you are like one of those banknotes that everyone reaches out to pull toward themselves!

units.source_text: 如此说来，我向你提出此人，是多嘴了，对不起她呢。”

en.t: If that is how it is, then it was meddlesome of me to bring her up to you, and I have wronged her.

units.source_text: 薰大将说：“岂不闻‘终当到浅滩’么？

en.t: General Kaoru said, Have you not heard that in the end one reaches the shallows?

units.source_text: 只是吾生渺茫，有如水泡。

en.t: Only, my own life is uncertain and fleeting, like a bubble on the water.

units.source_text: 唉，我真像被你抛在河中的‘抚物’，叫我何以慰情呢？”

en.t: Ah, I am truly like a purification doll cast by you into the river; how am I to comfort my heart?

units.source_text: 天色渐暮，客人不走，二女公子讨厌起来，劝他早归，说道：

en.t: As dusk gradually fell and the guest still would not leave, the Second Princess grew annoyed and urged him to go home early, saying,

units.source_text: “在此借宿的客人看了会诧怪的，今夜请你早些回去吧。”

en.t: The guest staying here will think it strange if he sees you, so please go back early tonight.

units.source_text: 薰大将说：“那么，请你向客人转达，说这是我多年来的夙愿，

en.t: General Kaoru said, In that case, please tell the guest that this has been my long-cherished wish for many years,

units.source_text: 决不是逢场作戏之类的浅薄行为。

en.t: and that it is certainly not some shallow act of idle flirtation.

units.source_text: 我平生不惯此道，遇事胆怯不前，实甚可笑呢。”

en.t: I have never been used to this sort of thing, and whenever something happens I grow timid and cannot move forward; it is truly laughable.

units.source_text: 如此叮嘱一番，就回去了。

en.t: After giving these instructions at length, he went home.
